high_level_description: This image is a movie poster for a Tamil film titled "Kaanum Pachcha" (which translates to "The Other Side"). The poster features a man prominently in the foreground, holding a large hammer over his shoulder. He has a confident and determined expression, with a slight smile, and is wearing sunglasses and a dark shirt. His hair is styled neatly, and he appears to be in a rugged, action-oriented role. In the background, there is a scene of a construction site or industrial area, with a yellow truck and some machinery visible.
